title: Pocket Internet
description:
Pocket Internet is an offline, standard-library-only Python demo for validating small public-information JSON bundles, importing them into local file libraries, and merging libraries carried between disconnected devices, with explicit expiry, supersession, and revision-conflict reporting. Devices exchange files manually; the program never opens a network connection.

Scope and limits. Research prototype. Its SHA-256 digests detect accidental changes only; they are not signatures and do not establish authenticity, safety, or truth of any message. Example bundles are SYNTHETIC; no field deployment or empirical performance is claimed.
